title: Metadata Application Policy Seam
problem: Addon writeback currently mixes protocol adaptation with host-owned Canonical Metadata application policy, lock-aware merge, catalog projection, and apply reporting.

evidence.summary: Opened host-owned metadata application seam lane and scoped Addon adapter cleanup plus bulk continuation as follow-ons.
Added characterization tests for Addon MissingOnly behavior, field locks, same-source lock refresh, catalog projection, safe apply reports, and scan-time writeback policy.
Added server app MetadataApplication Module for lock lookup, source-aware merge, catalog projection, and apply reporting.
Converted Addon metadata_write into a protocol Adapter and removed hard-coded FullRefresh from the Addon apply path.
Audited provider refresh and hierarchy confirmation; kept them in nako-metadata behind ports and deferred pure cross-crate extraction until reuse pressure is real.

continue_policy.notes: Host metadata application seam is complete for Addon writeback. Open official Addon adapter cleanup or scan Addon bulk continuation as separate follow-on lanes when prioritized.
